rec.name: Configurable Product Cards (Collection Grid)
rec.status: Backlog — scoping; dev proposed building it as a snippet inside main-collection (open question on quick-ATC variant handling)

what.text: A fully configurable product card for the collection (category) page grid. Each card has a product image with an optional slideshow (arrows), a corner icon badge, a colored benefit/icon bar under the image, an uppercase title, a subline, star rating with review count, a price, and optional text badges such as 'Bestseller' or 'Neu'. The ticket also specifies a CTA button, a quick add-to-cart, a base price, and hover effects. These are not visible in the mockup. The ticket originally asked for a standalone 'Produktkacheln' section. The developer replied that it should be a snippet embedded in the theme's main-collection section so filtering keeps working, and that each theme will likely need style adjustments.

why.text: Cards show the key purchase info (pack size, duration, price per unit, rating, status badges) before the click. This lowers the effort of comparing products and makes the card more persuasive. Star ratings and 'Bestseller'/'Neu' tags add social proof and quick-scan cues. The benefit bar and icon badges communicate value at a glance. A quick-ATC button on the card shortens the path to purchase, and the base price makes different pack sizes easy to compare.

how.text: Build the card as a snippet that extends the theme's product-item snippet. It reuses the existing product-image slideshow Jani already built. Render it inside the main-collection section, with all options exposed in that section's settings so the theme's filter/sort keeps working. Drive the badges from product tags (colors set in the editor, position set to left/right and top/bottom). Drive the text badges (up to 3), benefit badges and icon badges from product-level data (metafields or a dynamic source). Pull the base price from the Shopify backend. Integrate the reviews.io rating widget with a star color setting. The quick ATC is either a small bubble on the image (position, color, icon configurable) or a full-width button under the price. Open point from the comments: whether it adds the first variant or opens a variant picker for multi-variant products, as in the Focal theme. The mockup shows a rounded card with a soft shadow, a beige page background and a green-gray benefit bar attached to the bottom of the image.

items: Heading, subheadline and text: font, size, bold (heading/subheadline only), alignment (left/center)
Product selection: manual product picker and a cap on the number of products shown
Section background: color, optional background image
Grid layout: 2–4 columns, spacing/padding between cards, shadow or border on/off, hover effect (zoom, shadow, color change)
Card CTA button: show/hide, label, shape (round to square), color, alignment
Quick ATC: corner rounding; bubble on image (position, color, icon) or full-width button under the price
Image badges: managed via product tags, editor-set colors, position (left/right, top/bottom)
Reviews: show/hide, star color, reviews.io compatibility
Price: value, currency symbol, font, color, size, bold, alignment
Base price: pulled from the backend, color adjustable
Text badges: up to 3, set per product via a dynamic source with an editor text field, background and text color
Benefit badge variant 1: 1 icon + 1 text (like the Rosental mockup)
Benefit badge variant 2: 2 icons + 2 texts (like the TrueNature mockup), adjustable rounding, full card width
Icon badge: 4 icons side by side, optional hover effect, tap on mobile shows a short text popup (info-button logic), hover colors for background and text

dependencies.text: Theme's main-collection section and product-item snippet (the slideshow was already added to it by Jani). The reviews.io app for ratings. Product tags for image badges. Product-level fields (metafields or dynamic sources) for text badges, benefit badges and icon badges (inferred). Backend/unit price data for the base price. Style adjustments will likely be needed per theme because parent styles affect the card.

items: Collection page to PDP click-through rate
Add-to-cart rate from the collection page (quick ATC usage)
Revenue per session and AOV
Product card click distribution (position, badge type)
Icon badge hover/tap interactions
Collection page exit and bounce rate
Filter/sort usage (to confirm no regression)

images.caption: Collection page with a filter/sort bar above a 4-column grid of product cards. Each has a corner icon badge, slideshow arrows, a benefit bar, title, subline, star rating and price, and some cards show 'Bestseller'/'Neu' text badges.

Close-up of one card (TrueNature mockup): blue icon badge top-left, round slideshow arrows, green-gray benefit bar with 3 icon+text items (360 St, 180 Tage, 0,16€), uppercase title, subline, 4/5 stars with review count, price.
